10→challenge in the present writ petition.

electricity connection of the petitioner after the petitioner will deposit the admitted

petitioner.
3. Shri Baleshwar Chaturvedi, learned counsel appearing on behalf of Respondent-
Electricity Department placed before this Court an order dated 14th May, 2024
according to which a sum of Rs.1,07,838/- is due upon the petitioner.
4. After going through the aforesaid documents, counsel for the petitioner confined
20→his prayer and prayed that some easy installments should be made for depositing of
the aforesaid amount. He placed reliance upon Clause 6.15 of the U.P. Electricity
Supply Code, 2005 and argued that recovery of arrears would not be recoverable
after the period of two years from the date when such sum became first due unless
such sum has been shown continuously as recoverable as arrears of charges of
electricity supplied, and the supply of the electricity shall not be disconnected by
licensee for this reason. 
5. In response to the same Shri Baleshwar Chaturvedi, learned counsel appearing
on behalf of Respondent-Electricity placed reliance upon Clause 4.39 of the U.P.
Electricity Supply Code, 2005 in which procedure for re-connection has been
30→provided. It is stated in the aforesaid clause that in case the petitioner will apply for
new connection the same should be provided to him after depositing the due upon

rank of Executive Engineer shall grant installments. It is further provided that
Executive Engineer, / DGM/ and General Manager can grant up to maximum of
two, three or four monthly installments respectively. However first installment shall

not be less than 40% of the total amount. Clause-6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply
40→Code, 2005 reads as follows:-
"6.14 Installment Facility
(i) The Licensee may extend the facility of instalments to those consumers only who
are in financial distress. However, no waival of surcharge shall be allowed.
(ii) No officer below the rank of Executive Engineer shall grant instalments. The
Executive Engineer/ DGM/ and General Manager can grant upto maximum of two,
three or four monthly installments respectively. However, first installment shall not be
less than 40% of the total amount. Where the amount for installments exceeds Rs.
10,000/- (ten thousand) the consumer shall be asked to deposit post dated cheques of
the installments to the Licensee."
